observations.body: Jethro brings Moses’ family to God’s mountain, hears the deliverance from Egypt, blesses the LORD, offers sacrifices, and eats with Aaron and Israel’s elders.
observations.label: Jethro hears, blesses, and eats before God

observations.body: Jethro hears, blesses, and eats before God belongs to approach to mountain in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 18:1–12 supplies antecedent evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Before the assembly

observations.body: Horeb antecedents and the approach to Sinai prepare the Event without turning every wilderness scene into the public assembly.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 18:1–12 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Jethro hears, blesses, and eats before God prepares for the mountain encounter, but this passage does not yet contain the public covenant assembly.
payload.title: Jethro hears, blesses, and eats before God
